hook: If space were endless and eternal, every line of sight would end on a star, so the night sky would glow. It doesn't, and that is a clue.

chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area: clear of the bottom 25% and of the right-hand button column.
Subject: a dense field of white stars crowding the frame edges, fading to a calm black patch near the centre (an illustration).
Composition: stars crowd all four edges; one dark gap sits in the centre third; a thin teal line of sight runs from the lower middle toward the gap.
Lighting and treatment: white stars (#EEF0FF) on indigo night (#0B0F2A), soft bloom, subtle grain.
Mood: disbelief and quiet wonder.
Text: "A star every way." in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), centred in the lower middle, white with the last word teal (#4FE3C6).
Scientific accuracy: Olbers' paradox: in an endless, eternal universe every line of sight would end on a star; the real sky is dark partly because the universe has a finite age, so far light has not arrived yet.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo. It must read as a code-rendered illustration in the channel's look (indigo night #0B0F2A, teal #4FE3C6 light fronts, violet #5B3FD0).
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
